name: Namer
body:
Prerequisite(s) Words of Foundation class feature

Benefit(s): When you would learn a Word, you may instead learn the Word for a type of creature that would be summonable via a Summon Monster spell with spell level equal to half your Speaker level (minimum 1). Speaking the Word for a creature summons a copy of the creature within 30 feet of you that lasts for 1 minute per Speaker level and expends a use of the Ally Identifying Word. This is not the True Name of a specific creature, but instead the Word of Foundation for that type of creature.

This feat counts as having the ability to cast summon monster.

Speaker: A Pathfinder 1e class designed for use in the Lost Lands, © 2021, Michael Mars, Author Michael Mars Russell
